Retro roguelike tower defense where EVERYTHING is made of squares. Defend the core on a giant map of 121 plots with 1, 2 or 3 paths, pick from 20 towers and upgrade each one with 3 unique cards, and face enemies with over 200 variants and a boss every 5 waves. After each wave choose a retro card (relics, new towers or tower upgrades), unlock black plots, buy permanent upgrades with crystals, earn 12 achievements and compete on the 3-path global leaderboard. Available in 12 languages.
